scientific_integrity: The counterexample checks every clause of the source definition directly. The replacement theorem is proved from reconstruction, bounded synthesis, atom membership in M, and finite-p coordinate truncation. No computation or external theorem is used to infer the range statement.
scientific_limitations: The finding addresses only synthesis-range surjectivity under the published definition. It does not audit unrelated results in the source. The universal equality is equality after closure; the synthesis range itself need not be closed.
title: Exact synthesis-range replacement for Lipschitz \(p\)-approximate Schauder frames
